objective: Cerrar una certificación usable del kernel elástico antes de escalar fuerte: throughput útil, frontier genérico suficiente, transporte de claim, fan-in, atomización, recovery, tiempo humano y recursión acotada deben quedar medidos/reparados con evidencia; no generar trabajo por generar trabajo.
current_authority: Existing Work Graph / portfolio / allocator / Guide / Metabolism / PIN-claim-RETURN owners remain authoritative.
fan_in: Guide Integrator consumes lane returns + scale-readiness + async-QA + recursive PASS and materializes only grounded repairs; campaign closer judges final evidence.
definition_of_done: A recent-window receipt states SCALE_READY, TUNE_BEFORE_SCALE or BLOCKED with sample sizes and dominant loss classes.
Any dominant fixable generic bottleneck found in the campaign is either repaired+verified or closed with explicit external/capability boundary.
Generic frontier supply is measured separately from specialized capability-only frontier.
Human handoff/wait is included where observable; external chat time remains EXTERNAL_UNOBSERVED rather than guessed.
Recursive child generation is bounded by consumer, dedupe, max_depth/max_children/budget/TTL and produces no orphan explosion.
Final closer emits one next_scale_gate: HOLD, 20_30, 50, or larger only if evidence supports it; no automatic mass spawn claim.
No new scheduler, queue, CURRENT, liveness owner, worker family, storage authority or filler backlog is created.
